# SolarTrack

SolarTrack is a free iOS app that shows sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue
hour times for any location, with a sun-path dial, an AI photography assistant,
and a weather and blue-hour forecast. All sun calculations run locally on
device; no location data ever leaves the phone.

## Pages
- /        : Home — what SolarTrack does, features, how light works, FAQ, download
- /privacy : Privacy policy (local-only computation, no data collection)

## Key facts
- Free on iOS (App Store)
- Works offline for all sun times; weather forecast is optional/online
- Covers every latitude and longitude in the world
- Does not collect, store or share personal location data
- Golden hour ≈ 60 min after sunrise / before sunset; blue hour ≈ 20–30 min
